description: Coastal Levees is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. A dataset depicting coastal levees captured by the Department of Primary Industries for the Future Coasts Program in 2011 using aerial imagery and the Future Coasts topographic LiDAR Digital Elevation Model (DEM). Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are  atmosphere,  meteorology, Climatology, Environment, Geoscientific information. It offers 7 resource(s) in dwg, dxf, extended tab, gdb, mif. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
